<!-- Gerado por scripts/gerar.mjs — Pós Phorte: Home 1/3, hero (inclui estilos e script da home). Colar inteiro em um widget HTML do Elementor. -->
<style>
/* Base compartilhada pelos widgets do cabeçalho, da home e do rodapé. */
/* Arial ajustada às medidas da Poppins enquanto ela carrega: o texto não muda de largura na troca (CLS).
   size-adjust medido no navegador (largura Poppins ÷ Arial); ascent/descent/line-gap = 105/35/10 % da Poppins ÷ size-adjust. */
@font-face{font-family:PhortePoppinsFallback;src:local("Arial"),local("ArialMT");font-weight:400;size-adjust:112.71%;ascent-override:93.16%;descent-override:31.05%;line-gap-override:8.87%}
@font-face{font-family:PhortePoppinsFallback;src:local("Arial"),local("ArialMT");font-weight:500;size-adjust:113.63%;ascent-override:92.41%;descent-override:30.8%;line-gap-override:8.8%}
@font-face{font-family:PhortePoppinsFallback;src:local("Arial Bold"),local("Arial-BoldMT");font-weight:600;size-adjust:106.71%;ascent-override:98.4%;descent-override:32.8%;line-gap-override:9.37%}
@font-face{font-family:PhortePoppinsFallback;src:local("Arial Bold"),local("Arial-BoldMT");font-weight:700;size-adjust:107.27%;ascent-override:97.88%;descent-override:32.63%;line-gap-override:9.32%}

:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes){--hp-primary:#d42b2b;--hp-primary-dark:#a81e1e;--hp-ink:#1a1a1a;--hp-muted:#595959;--hp-background:#fafafa;--hp-soft:#f4f6f9;--hp-border:#dedee3;--hp-radius:12px;--hp-columns:1;font-family:PhorteHomePoppins,Poppins,PhortePoppinsFallback,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;font-weight:400;color:var(--hp-ink);background:var(--hp-background);text-align:left;isolation:isolate;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) *,:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) *::before,:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) :where(h1,h2,h3,h4,p,ul,ol,figure,blockquote,form){margin:0;padding:0}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) :where(h1,h2,h3,h4){font-family:inherit;font-style:normal;color:inherit;letter-spacing:normal;text-transform:none;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes){font-synthesis:none}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) :where(ul,ol){list-style:none}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) :where(a){color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) :where(img){max-width:100%;display:block;height:auto}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) :where(button,input,select,summary){font:inherit;color:inherit;letter-spacing:normal}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) :where(button){cursor:pointer;text-transform:none;border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;background:none}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) :where(input,select){width:100%;min-width:0;margin:0;box-shadow:none;text-transform:none}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) :where(button,a,input,select,summary,[tabindex]):focus-visible{outline:3px solid #2164c5;outline-offset:4px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) :is(.hp-highlight>a,.hp-course-card>a,.hp-news-card>a,.hp-video-play):focus-visible{outline-offset:-5px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) [hidden]{display:none!important}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-container{width:min(1200px,calc(100% - 40px));margin-inline:auto}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) svg{width:22px;height:22px;flex-shrink:0}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) [id]{scroll-margin-top:24px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;min-height:52px;padding:14px 24px;border:1px solid var(--hp-primary);border-radius:8px;background:var(--hp-primary);color:#fff;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .2s,border-color .2s,transform .2s}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-button:hover{background:var(--hp-primary-dark);border-color:var(--hp-primary-dark);transform:translateY(-2px)}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-button--small{min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;font-size:12px;gap:10px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-button--light{background:#fff;border-color:#fff;color:var(--hp-primary-dark)}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-button--light:hover{background:#f5eeee;border-color:#f5eeee}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-button--outline{background:transparent;border-color:var(--hp-border);color:var(--hp-ink)}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-button--outline:hover{border-color:var(--hp-primary);background:#fff;color:var(--hp-primary)}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-eyebrow{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;line-height:1.6;color:var(--hp-primary);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px}

@media(max-width:767px){
  :is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-container{width:calc(100% - 40px)}
  :is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-eyebrow{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  :is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) *,:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) *::before,:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) *::after{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important;animation:none!important}
}

:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-section{padding-block:76px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-section-title{max-width:760px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-section-title h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,40px);text-wrap:balance}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-intro{color:var(--hp-muted);max-width:680px;margin-top:18px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.8}

/* Hero da Pós: três slides e controles independentes dos catálogos. */
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#171719;color:#fff}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 95% 80%,#57171975,transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-grid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:50px;align-items:center;padding-top:62px;padding-bottom:32px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero .hp-eyebrow{color:#f4aaaa}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero :is(h1,h2){font-size:clamp(34px,3.5vw,50px);line-height:1.2;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:normal;max-width:640px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:#f29c9c}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-description{color:#d0cfd3;font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;max-width:555px;margin-top:24px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;margin-top:30px;flex-wrap:wrap}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-text-link{font-size:13px;color:#fff;padding-block:12px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-modalities{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:30px;max-width:580px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-modalities a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:34px;border:1px solid #ffffff36;border-radius:100px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:10px;color:#e6e4e7}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-modalities a:hover{border-color:#f29c9c;color:#fff}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-art{position:relative;min-width:0;align-self:center;padding-bottom:30px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-art>img{width:100%;max-width:480px;aspect-ratio:1;margin-inline:auto;object-fit:contain}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-note{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:4px;display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;background:#ffffff0b;border:1px solid #ffffff24;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);padding:17px 22px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.8}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-note strong{font-weight:500}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-note-line{height:34px;width:3px;background:#f29c9c;border-radius:2px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-track{position:relative;transition:height .35s ease}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-slide{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;min-width:0;transition:opacity .35s ease,visibility .35s ease}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-slide[data-active="true"]{position:relative;inset:auto;opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-slide--image{background:#981e23}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-slide--image picture{display:block;width:100%}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-slide--image img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-course-list{display:grid;gap:18px;padding-block:30px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-course-preview{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;min-width:0;padding:16px;border:1px solid #ffffff36;border-radius:12px;background:#242124;color:#fff;transition:border-color .2s,background-color .2s}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-course-preview:hover{border-color:#f29c9c;background:#34272c}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-course-preview>img{width:92px;height:88px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 20%;border-radius:6px;flex-shrink:0}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-course-preview>span:not(.hp-hero-mba){flex:1;min-width:0}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-course-preview small{display:block;color:#f4aaaa;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em;margin-bottom:6px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-course-preview strong{display:block;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.55}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-course-preview>svg{width:20px;height:20px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-mba{width:92px;height:88px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;background:#42282c;border-radius:6px;font-size:20px;color:#f29c9c;font-weight:600}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-controls{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 20px 82px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-control{width:44px;height:44px;padding:0;border:1px solid #ffffffb8;border-radius:50%;background:#171719a6;color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-control:hover{background:#fff;color:#1a1a1a}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-control svg{width:20px;height:20px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) [data-hero-prev]>svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-pagination{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-dot{width:28px;min-height:44px;padding:0;display:grid;place-items:center}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-dot>span{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:10px;background:#a59b9f;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-dot[aria-current="true"]{width:68px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-dot[aria-current="true"]>span{width:60px;background:#a59b9f;height:9px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-progress{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;background:#fff;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left center}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-dot[aria-current="true"].is-progressing .hp-hero-progress{animation:hp-hero-progress 5s linear forwards}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) [data-rotation-running="false"] .hp-hero-progress{animation-play-state:paused}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-rotation[aria-pressed="true"] .hp-hero-play,:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-rotation[aria-pressed="false"] .hp-hero-pause{display:none}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-hero-track{touch-action:pan-y pinch-zoom}
@keyframes hp-hero-progress{from{transform:scaleX(0)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-demo-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:500;background:var(--hp-soft);padding:6px 11px;border:1px solid #e8e8ed;border-radius:100px;color:var(--hp-muted);white-space:nowrap}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-input-icon{position:relative}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-input-icon svg{position:absolute;top:15px;left:12px;width:18px;height:18px;color:#72727c;pointer-events:none}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-input-icon input{padding-left:39px}

/* Destaques em seis cards. */
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-highlights{padding-top:72px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-highlight-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px;margin-top:36px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-highlight{min-width:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--hp-border);border-radius:var(--hp-radius);overflow:hidden;transition:box-shadow .2s,transform .2s}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-highlight:hover{box-shadow:0 12px 30px #0000000c;transform:translateY(-4px)}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-highlight>a{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-highlight-image{aspect-ratio:16/10;overflow:hidden;background:#eee;position:relative}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-highlight-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 20%;transform:scale(1.2)}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-highlight-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;padding:25px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-highlight-number{color:#666;font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;margin-bottom:13px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-highlight h3{font-size:21px;line-height:1.35;font-weight:600}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-highlight-copy>p{font-size:13px;color:var(--hp-muted);line-height:1.8;margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:24px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-card-link{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--hp-primary);margin-top:auto;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #ececf0}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-card-link svg{width:20px;height:20px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-visagismo{background:#262327;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:32px;isolation:isolate}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-visagismo::before{content:"";position:absolute;border:1px solid #e7929259;border-radius:50%;width:240px;height:240px;right:-50px;top:-70px;z-index:-1}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-visagismo span{font-size:24px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:-.04em}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-visagismo em{font-style:normal;color:#f29c9c}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-visagismo b{position:absolute;right:22px;bottom:18px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;font-weight:500;color:#d2c5c5}

/* Catálogo: trilhos nativos, sem dependência de bibliotecas. */
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-catalog{background:#1a1a1d;color:#fff;--hp-muted:#c1bfc7}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-catalog .hp-eyebrow{color:#f29c9c}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-area-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:26px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-area-nav a{padding:9px 17px;border:1px solid #ffffff40;border-radius:100px;font-size:12px;min-height:42px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-area-nav a:hover{background:#fff;color:#1a1a1d}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-course-group{margin-top:44px;padding-top:32px;border-top:1px solid #ffffff26;min-width:0}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-group-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:24px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-group-heading .hp-eyebrow{font-size:9px;margin-bottom:7px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-group-heading h3{font-size:26px;letter-spacing:normal}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-carousel-arrows{display:flex;gap:10px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-carousel-arrows button{width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid #ffffff50;border-radius:50%;color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:background-color .2s}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-carousel-arrows [data-prev] svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-carousel-arrows button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#ffffff20}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-carousel-arrows button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-track{display:flex;gap:24px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;overscroll-behavior-inline:contain;scrollbar-width:none;padding:4px 4px 12px;scroll-padding-inline:4px;touch-action:pan-x pan-y;cursor:grab}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-track.hp-dragging{scroll-snap-type:none;cursor:grabbing;user-select:none}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-course-card{flex:0 0 calc((100% - (var(--hp-columns) - 1)*24px)/var(--hp-columns));min-width:0;scroll-snap-align:start;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;color:#1a1a1a}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-course-card>a{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%;-webkit-user-drag:none}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-course-image{height:auto;aspect-ratio:1.65;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#eee}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-course-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 30%;transition:transform .35s;-webkit-user-drag:none}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-course-card:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-course-tag{position:absolute;top:14px;left:14px;padding:5px 9px;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;color:#333;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-course-copy{padding:22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-course-area{color:#68686d;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:9px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-course-copy h4{font-size:18px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:normal;min-height:82px;margin-bottom:22px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-carousel-bottom{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;margin-top:10px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-carousel-status{font-size:11px;color:#c1bfc7}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-carousel-dots{display:flex;gap:0;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-carousel-dots button{width:24px;height:32px;position:relative;padding:0}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-carousel-dots button::after{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#77737f;position:absolute;top:13px;left:9px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-carousel-dots button[aria-current="true"]::after{background:#fff;width:8px;height:8px;left:8px;top:12px}

/* Pessoas e depoimentos. */
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-coordinators{background:#f4f6f9}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-coordinator-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:30px 20px;margin-top:36px}
:is(#hp-home-hero,#hp-home-secoes) .hp-portrait{aspect-ratio:1;overflow:hidden;background:#e3e3e7;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:19px}
